user: TICKET # When an Exception is thrown with a string code, there is a fatal error Like DBPdo that will throw this error: - SQLSTATE[42S22]: Column not found: 1054 Unknown column '%s' in 'where clause'" - Error code: 42S22 As you can see, the error code is not an integer but a string. As we have a strict type and that Exception need an int as the $code paramterers, it's throw a fatal error. ## Étapes 1. Make a select with a missing colum into the where clause (use DbQuery for that) 2. See the fatal error --- 1. Install this module [test.zip](https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/files/8464689/test.zip) 2. Go to FO 3. See error ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/23308427/162754674-70124d66-6700-4462-8e77-052f7e8bde9f.png) ÉTAPE 1 LOCALISER. Réponds en JSON : {"keywords": ["...", "..."]} (3 à 8 mots-clés).
